v0.5.2d: content architecture + JSON parity — work.json, services.json, products.json created. Work/Services/Products pages now rendered from JSON via app.js. CMS-ready structure with stable ids, public-safe status fields, and clear grouping.

v0.5.2e: Products/Labs redesign — AION shelf (3-col, teaser framing, private/internal distinction) + labs/proof registry grid (4-col, status tags, icons). projects.html restructured with two content sections. All items driven from content/products.json. adg_ops publicSafe corrected to true.

v0.5.2f: Services/Method editorial redesign — page reframed as Práctica / Método (nav label SERVICES/METHOD unchanged). Offers now render as an editorial offer list (index, sentence-case title/body, format tag); method renders as a connected stepper diagram (numbered nodes, rail line, hover/focus highlight, reduced-motion safe). services.json copy de-uppercased and given step numbers + tags. method.html legacy route copy aligned to new naming.

v0.5.2g: Work case/project system — work.html rebuilt with a sticky left project rail (scrollspy via IntersectionObserver) and N-ready alternating case rows (info + 16:9 visual frame, inverted on even rows). Each case renders title, type · status, problem/system/output meta, public-safety note, and a 16:9 image-or-placeholder. Only publicSafe:true items render; ADG-OPS is the single Proyecto 01. No private/prohibited cases exposed.

v0.5.2h: Home strengthening — index.html reframed around the Collapse Creative → CCDV lineage thesis (anti-hype, design/comms/experience origin). New editorial rhythm: hero (logo/frame untouched, lead rooted in BP) → lineage band (Origen/Unidad two-col + arrow) → process sequence diagram (problema → sistema → software, reusing the method stepper) → offer entry linking to Práctica / Método → ADG-OPS controlled proof with 16:9 frame → Products/Labs + OpenVibe ecosystem teaser → contact CTA. Sentence-case, no hype, no AI-magic claims. Home remains static HTML; no OpenVibe form changes.

v0.5.2i: public blocker hygiene — asset cache-busting (styles.css?v=0.5.2i, app.js?v=0.5.2i on all HTML pages), JS render failure fallback (renderContentFallback helper in app.js, safe textContent insertion into first available content container), no-JS noscript fallback blocks on work/services/projects/openvibe, mojibake fix (conexión restored in app.js form error message).

v0.5.2j: Products/Labs and Work data governance correction — AION internal tools visibility governance corrected, Labs registry cleaned, ADG-OPS/HTW Generator moved to Work, Laus Ops and HTW Web added as coming-soon work entries.
v0.5.2j2: Work rail left-site hotfix — rail repositioned into the Work page left site gutter on desktop, with safe responsive fallback.

v0.5.2j4: Work rail real sticky hotfix — wraps rail content in an inner sticky element so the left-site Work rail follows scroll correctly inside the Work section. CSS sticky confirmed failed in real browser smoke (innerTop tracked outerTop exactly; position:sticky did not activate). Superseded by v0.5.2j5 bounded fixed behavior.

v0.5.2j5: Work rail bounded fixed hotfix — CSS sticky was unreliable in the current scroll architecture, so the Work rail now uses a scoped desktop-only bounded fixed behavior inside the Work section.
v0.5.2k: ADG-OPS governance trace alignment — stale proof/publicNow wording updated to reflect first CCDV commission, private beta status, and future public release framing.
v0.5.2l: AION visual highlight system — Products/Labs now uses subtle public-safe accent metadata and rendering for AION internal tools without changing their access/status framing.
v0.5.2m: Header/main boundary cleanup — page hero top border disabled so the fixed header remains the sole owner of the navbar/content seam on inner pages.
v0.5.2n: Services desktop layout tuning — services offer matrix width and tag contrast adjusted so offer titles and tags remain visually connected on desktop while preserving responsive behavior.

v0.5.2o: Home offers and Work rail rebuild — Home offer rows constrained for desktop pairing; Work rail simplified back to CSS sticky after excluding the Work section from motion reveal transforms and removing the broken fixed-position fallback.
v0.5.2p: Public hygiene cache and UTF-8 cleanup — public HTML asset query strings aligned to the current release and Work page mojibake corrected without changing layout or content data.

v0.5.3: Visual balance and Work rail removal — Work rail removed completely after browser review; page heroes compacted globally; Home and Services left-column sections gained right-side visual containers for desktop balance.

v0.5.3a: Interactive service graphics correction — Home entry module redesigned as a service-to-CCDV-to-output flow; Services offer tags removed and the service list now drives an interactive selected-service graphic; oversized static placeholders reduced. Corrects v0.5.3.

v0.5.3b: Code hygiene and de-monolith pass — public HTML pages formatted for readable diffs; service-flow JavaScript and CSS organized for human/LLM maintainability without intentional visual or content changes.
v0.5.3c: Service-flow visual polish — Home and Services interactive graphics refined from rough stacked boxes into quieter editorial system diagrams; interaction behavior and content data preserved.

v0.5.4: Schematic grammar lock — CCDV Visual Language v1 formalized as outline-first, thin-line, blueprint/schematic primitives; private roadmap updated with the identity track; public CSS tokens/primitives added without module redesign.

v0.5.5: Home flagship schematic — "Por dónde se entra" redesigned as a five-input to CCDV-core to five-output schematic system map using Visual Language v1; Services remains unchanged for the next flagship step.

v0.5.6: Services flagship schematic — "Sistema de servicios" redesigned as a selected-service input/problema to CCDV-proceso to output schematic pipeline (with a static criterio gate) using Visual Language v1; the offer list is the keyboard selector and the aria-hidden figure mirrors the active service. Home flagship remains unchanged except cache-bust. VISUAL SMOKE FAILED — stacked card boxes remained; not committed.

v0.5.6a: Services blueprint corrective — replaced the failed stacked text/card service schematic with a white technical blueprint canvas and five distinct service-specific SVG diagrams; fixed left service index/active-state alignment (vertical bar replaced with bottom rule); v0.5.6 remains a failed visual attempt in history.
